As background, I read feat.design (SE-3, SE-4) and feat.clarifications (CL-X9, CL-DS4, CL-DS8). improvements: Several citations use the form 'journey:feat.clarifications (...)' and 'journey:feat.design (...)'. The brief's allowed citation forms do not include 'journey:'. These files were read from the design agent's outputs, so they should be cited as file:hobasa-design-agent/outputs/FEAT-ZD-48600/feat.clarifications.md and file:hobasa-design-agent/outputs/FEAT-ZD-48600/feat.design.md. The content they point to (CL-DS4, CL-DS8, CL-X9, SE-3, SE-4) is accurate.

The 'Secrets read by today's code' row cites only explain.py, models.json and test_forecast.py, but it describes a search of the whole repository. Citing ci.py, predict.py and src/ap_forecast/__init__.py as well, or naming the search scope, would make the 'whole repository' claim easier to check.

SSQ-1 (who holds the acme-llm provider credential when a request is actually sent) is reasonable to raise as non-blocking. It could also note that feat.design's re-trigger list counts 'any storage or network call from the libraries' as a trigger, so any sender that needs a credential would sit outside this design.
judge.notes:
I checked every statement in task.secrets_scope.md against the sources. The fix from the previous refusal holds: the CI command `/usr/bin/python3 ci.py` is now cited to README.md (line 3) and CLAUDE.md (line 5) in ap_forecast, and both state it word for word.

The description of ci.py (compile, unit tests, coverage gate, static checks, and no secret or environment-variable reads) matches ci.py.

The build_explanation_request return keys (provider, model, max_tokens, messages) match explain.py. The values acme-llm and acme-text-2 match models.json.

The statement that predict_delay_days computes in memory matches predict.py.

I ran my own search of ap_forecast for secret, key, token, credential, password, environ and getenv. It matched only max_tokens in explain.py and models.json and the max_tokens assertions in test_forecast.py, which agrees with the output.

CL-DS4, CL-DS8, CL-X9, SE-3, SE-4 and TQ-8 are quoted accurately from feat.clarifications and feat.design. The TSK-03 and TSK-04 details, commit b0fd4d2 and the owner/gate line match feat.tasks and the brief.

The empty secrets scope matches the recorded tool result: 'no secrets required or granted (permission table)'.

No invented facts, numbers or contradictions were found. The open questions are framed correctly as non-blocking, with interim answers. The only weaknesses are the non-standard 'journey:' citation prefix and the narrow citation for the repository-wide search.
